data.name: Gogal
data.gender_notes: Gogal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word for 'sun'. The name Gogal carries the meaning “Sun” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gogal usually hope their child will grow to embody sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes energy, warmth, and life-giving qualities.
data.etymology: Gogal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gogal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: غوغال
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الشخص الذي يملك قوة داخلية و روحية
in_arabic.long_meaning: غوغال هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذور اللغوية العربية، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك قوة داخلية وروحية، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالشخصيات الروحية والزعماء الدينيين في التاريخ الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: گوگال
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو اندرونی طاقت اور روحانی طاقت کا مالک شخص پر دلالت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: گوگال ایک عربی نام ہے جو عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ اس شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو اندرونی اور روحانی قوتوں کا حامل ہو، جو اسلامی تاریخ میں روحانی رہنماؤں اور مذہبی زعماء کے ساتھ منسلک ہے.

in_hindi.name: गोगल
in_hindi.meaning: आंतरिक शक्ति और आध्यात्मिक शक्ति वाले व्यक्ति को दर्शाने वाला नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: गोगल एक अरबी नाम है जो अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, और यह उस व्यक्ति को संबोधित करता है जो आंतरिक और आध्यात्मिक शक्तियों का धारक है, जो इस्लामी इतिहास में आध्यात्मिक नेताओं और धार्मिक व्यक्तियों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: ګوګل
in_pashto.meaning: داخلي ځواک او روحاني ځواک لرونکي کس ته اشاره کوونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ګوګل يو عربي نوم دى چې د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوى دى، او دا هغه کس ته خطاب کوي چې داخلي او روحاني قواوو حامل دی، کوم چې د اسلامي تاريخ کې د روحاني مشرانو او مذهبي زعيمانو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Gogal
in_english.meaning: Name signifying a person with inner strength and spiritual power
in_english.long_meaning: Gogal is an Arabic name derived from linguistic roots, referring to an individual possessing inner and spiritual strength, often associated with spiritual leaders and religious figures in Islamic history.

pronunciation.pashto: ګوګل د ګو ګال په توګه تلفظ کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Gogal" holds a special significance in Arabic culture due to its ties to the sun. Sun plays an important role in various Arabic traditions, customs, and rituals. It is a symbol of life-giving force and warmness. Therefore, a name like "Gogal," which denotes the sun, may evoke feelings of vitality, power, and vitality in those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Gogal" can be seen as a reminder of the sun's divine power and radiance. The Islamic faith teaches that the sun is a created entity and a sign from Allah, the Almighty. Reflecting upon this name can inspire one to recognize and appreciate the divine power that surrounds us in our daily lives. Additionally, the Arabic word "gal" means "leading," suggesting a spiritual commitment to living a purposeful and virtuous life, guided by the light of knowledge and wisdom, much like the brightness of the sun illuminating the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Sun" symbolizes Derived from the Arabic word for 'sun'.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Gogal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of sun.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's Travels, 1332-1354 AD, Morocco. He mentioned a town named 'Gogal' located in the interior of Morocco, near the Arabian Sea coast, west of the Niger Bend and near the Atlantic Ocean.
historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta was a famous traveler from Morocco who documented his journeys in a book known as 'Rihla'. He described a town named 'Gogal' in his travels through Morocco.

historical_references.reference: Al-Idrisi's Geography, 1154 AD, Maghreb. He mentioned a town named 'Gogal' located in the western part of present-day Algeria, near the Mediterranean coast.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi was a famous Arab geographer who wrote a comprehensive geography book known as 'Nuzhat al-Mushtaq fi Ikhtiraq al-Afrah'. He described a town named 'Gogal' in his account of the Maghreb region.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Gogal remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Gogal from Istanbul, Turkey embodies the meaning of Gogal - "Sun". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
